name: English
heroCopy: The international country event arrives in Barcelona. Three days of line dance, live music and American spirit.
festivalCopy: Barcelona Country Festival brings together three days of international line dance, live music, quality western products and food trucks with authentic American barbecue. An event for dancers, families and country lovers looking for the real American spirit in Barcelona.
lineupIntro: Europe’s leading Country Line Dance names, together in Barcelona.

artists.name: Pol F. Ryan
artists.body: An international Catalan Style Line Dance icon and a highly sought-after performer worldwide. His choreographies are danced across Europe, blending American energy with Mediterranean flavor. A true force on the dance floor.

artists.name: Algaly Fofana
artists.body: One of the freshest young figures in European Line Dance. A must at the biggest events, he has taken his style to Belgium, Spain and Italy through viral choreographies.

artists.name: David Villellas
artists.body: A true Catalan Country Style legend and the pioneer of this style in Europe. After more than 20 years on stage, his choreographies have conquered international festivals. Every major event needs his unmistakable presence.

artists.name: Sofía Balzano
artists.body: A young figure in the new generation of European Line Dance. Her choreographies bring together personality, energy and a contemporary take on Country Style.

artists.name: Montse Moscardó
artists.body: An essential name in the Catalan Country Style scene. Her precise, energetic choreographies are danced at hundreds of events throughout Europe.

artists.name: Johnny
artists.body: Gianmarco Rossato combines Italian DNA with an international soul. Since 2013, he has created dances built on musicality, structure and a special connection with the people who fill the dance floor.

artists.name: David Prestor
artists.body: David Prestor is a renowned Slovenian Country Line Dance choreographer. He stands out for his versatility, creating choreographies that range from beginner level to advanced and dynamic dances, including popular titles on the scene such as On The Road Again and Pay Me My Money Down.

artists.name: Laura Jones
artists.body: Laura Jones is a European figure recognised throughout the country world, an instructor and choreographer. She is known on the international scene for her infectious, accessible choreographies. For two decades, together with her husband Jonatan, she has promoted the major Western Experience event in the Netherlands, an essential stop on the Country Tour.

artists.name: Silvia Denise
artists.body: Silvia Denise is an influential Italian Country Line Dance instructor and choreographer, recognised across the international community for her dynamic creations and passionate teaching. Her style connects dancers of every level at festivals and events. She is a leading promoter of the Voghera Country Festival and the Bologna Country Festival.

artists.name: Virginie Barjaud
artists.body: Virginie Barjaud is a renowned French choreographer with strong ties to Catalan Style. Founder of the WANTED troupe, she teaches workshops across Europe, sharing her enthusiasm and passion for western culture through popular creations such as Backroad.

artists.name: Silvia Calsina
artists.body: Silvia Calsina is a leading Country Line Dance choreographer and instructor, and a key figure in promoting and sharing country dance. Known for her technique and charisma, she teaches international workshops and creates popular choreographies that bring every dance floor she visits to life.

artists.name: Neus Lloveras
artists.body: Neus Lloveras is a major figure in Country Line Dance and one of the pioneers of Catalan Style. As an instructor and choreographer, she stands out for her energy, technical precision and dynamic choreographies that advance authentic western culture on dance floors and at international festivals.

artists.name: Jonathan Jones
artists.body: A DJ and true European legend who commands the floor with every track he selects. His humor and stage presence drive the crowd wild. Essential to us.

artists.name: Steve Frapolli
artists.body: An Italian DJ and an essential figure at major European country festivals. Decades of experience, a philosopher and intellectual of country music, and the author of several books on music. He brings a precise music selection and tireless energy to keep the dance floor buzzing.

ref.storyBefore: The song that gets you on the dance floor. A choreography you finally share with its creator. That last dance that always turns into one more. That’s what awaits you at
ref.storyAfter: : three days of dance workshows where you can learn new choreographies, live music and meeting people around the dance floor. Bring your friends, discover the western atmosphere and take a break with food trucks and American barbecue. Then, get back to dancing.
